newsitem.title: USA: American Oilfield sweetens takeover offer.
newsitem.headline: American Oilfield sweetens takeover offer.

text.p: American Oilfield Divers Inc said Friday its AOD Acquisition Corp had increased its takeover offer for Hard Suits Inc to C$1.65/US$1.2045 per share from C$1.50/US$1.096.
AOD has also offered a C$500,000/US$365,000 line of credit to Hard Suits to allow it to immediately address its working capital deficiency during the offer period, American Oilfield said.

The line of credit, which may be increased, is conditional on Hard Suits Chairman Rene Theophil Nuytten resigning as a director and officer, and one American Oilfield nominee being appointed to Hard Suits's board of directors, it said.
The company previously announced that its offer would expire at 12:01 a.m. October 30.

American Oilfield has criticized Hard Suits's C$2.5 million/US$1.825 million loan agreement, which was reached after American Oilfield's first takeover offer, calling it contrary to the best interests of Hard Suits shareholders.
